validation_notes: This fixture has no must_not_fire list because the test contract is about engine behavior on a dialect-confused cfg, not about a specific rule's silence.
If the engine silently treats sanity.so / secfilter.so / kex.so as valid OpenSIPS modules and runs rules against the surrounding code as if it were standard OpenSIPS, that is a parser defect.

If the engine halts with OSIPS-SEC-CFG-PARSE-ERROR on the first Kamailio-only directive, F2-F5 may not be reached. That's acceptable — the parse error is the primary contract; the others are nice-to-have if the engine continues.
